record.name: Intercom
record.one_liner: Intercom provides an AI-powered customer service platform with APIs and SDKs for building integrations and apps.

auth.notes: Public apps require setting up OAuth, while private apps can use an Access Token.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a free account to create a development workspace and access the Developer Hub.

api_surface.notes: The platform provides REST APIs, webhooks, and SDKs (including mobile SDKs and Canvas Kit).

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve developer accounts are available to obtain credentials and test integrations, but public apps require OAuth configuration and submission to the Intercom team for review.

evidence.claim: Public apps require setting up OAuth and submitting to the Intercom team for review, whereas private apps can use an Access Token without review.
Developers can sign up to create a free account and development workspace to access the Developer Hub and configure webhooks and OAuth.
Integrations can be built using REST APIs and the Canvas Kit framework.
